value: Scott Aaronson, a theoretical computer scientist, presents his "reform" approach to AI alignment, advocating a shift from abstract, philosophical concerns about existential risk to focusing on concrete, tractable problems. He argues that the emergence of powerful language models like GPT now allows for empirical progress and scientific feedback in AI safety, similar to other successful fields. A primary example is his work on statistical watermarking of AI-generated text, a method to detect bot-generated content and mitigate immediate misuses like academic cheating and mass propaganda. Aaronson posits that AI capabilities, including deception, will likely emerge gradually, allowing for continuous learning and intervention, rather than a sudden, unmanageable "foom" scenario. He further champions transparency and democratic governance in AI development, believing openness fosters public understanding and enables timely policy responses, which was a key motivation for his transition into the field.
